text: Bf1 is the most accurate move, maintaining White's advantage (+4.95, Stockfish:16) on [pv:Bf1 e3 Rd7 e2]. After ...e3 Black can fight back against White's pressure, yet White still keeps a decisive edge in the continuation. Kd2 was clearly weaker by comparison, as it leads to a clear advantage for Black after [pv:Kd2 Qxb1 Bh5 Rb8 Ke2].
